courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering
aliases: Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science
Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science and Engineering
Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science and Engineering
courses.summary: This catalogue category covers undergraduate engineering degrees in computer science and engineering, usually four years after an upper-secondary qualification with mathematics. Typical curricula run from programming, data structures, operating systems, databases and computer networks to algorithms, software engineering and electives in artificial intelligence, machine learning, cloud and security, with project and internship components.

courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering
aliases: Bachelor of Electronics and Communication Engineering
courses.summary: This catalogue category covers undergraduate engineering degrees in electronics and communication engineering, usually four years after upper-secondary physics, chemistry and mathematics. Curricula typically span circuit and network theory, analog and digital electronics, signals and systems, digital signal processing, communication systems and embedded or VLSI design, with laboratory and project work.

courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
aliases: Bachelor of Electrical and Electronic Engineering
courses.summary: This catalogue category covers four-year undergraduate degrees in electrical and electronics engineering taken after an upper-secondary qualification with physics and mathematics. Programmes typically cover circuit theory, electrical machines, power systems, power electronics, control systems and embedded electronics, with laboratory work and electives in renewable energy or electric mobility.
courses.metaTitle: B.E./B.Tech EEE Degrees for International Students

courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering
courses.summary: A four-year undergraduate engineering degree covering engineering mechanics, thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, machine design, manufacturing processes and control systems. Teaching is built around workshop practice, thermal and materials laboratories, computer-aided design and a final-year project. Graduates move into manufacturing, automotive, energy, thermal and design roles, or continue to a master's specialisation such as thermal engineering or machine design.

cover.altText: Students working in a computer laboratory at Panimalar Engineering College

universities.summary: Panimalar Engineering College is a private autonomous college at Poonamallee, Chennai, affiliated to Anna University. Its regular portfolio includes four-year undergraduate engineering degrees and two-year M.E. and MBA programmes. Entry qualifications, selection and fees depend on the exact award and admission category.
universities.campusLifestyle: The Poonamallee campus provides separate student hostels, computer laboratories and departmental learning facilities. Hostel residents have access to furnished rooms, Wi-Fi, fitness facilities and medical support. The college’s IDEA Lab supports hands-on design and prototyping activities.
universities.cityProfile: The main college is on Bangalore Trunk Road at Varadharajapuram, Poonamallee, Chennai 600123, in Thiruvallur district. The 2026 TNEA college directory identifies Chennai Central as the nearest railway station, about 20 km away. Students should plan travel around the main Poonamallee teaching campus.
universities.practicalExposure: The undergraduate regulations organize study over eight semesters and include laboratory and project components. The IDEA Lab supports practical design, electronics and prototyping activity, with facilities for developing and testing student ideas. These resources complement branch-specific coursework; access to a laboratory or placement activity does not guarantee an internship or employment offer.
universities.hostelOverview: Separate permanent boys’ and girls’ hostels are listed in the 2026 TNEA directory. For each, annual mess, room and electricity charges are listed as ₹50,000, ₹50,000 and ₹35,000 respectively: ₹1,35,000 combined. Confirm the applicable room, current payable charges and refund conditions before booking.
universities.dietarySupport: The 2026 TNEA directory records both vegetarian and non-vegetarian mess provision for boys’ and girls’ hostels. Students with allergies or other dietary needs should confirm suitable meals before committing to accommodation.
universities.safetyOverview: The college publishes an anti-ragging contact through the TNEA directory. Its hostel facilities include medical support and a doctor on call. Students should obtain campus emergency and hostel contact details during joining.
universities.studentSupport: Departmental learning facilities and the IDEA Lab support academic and practical work. Hostel residents have access to Wi-Fi and fitness facilities. Students Traffic can help applicants review branch prerequisites and prepare their application records.
whyChoose: Choose among computing, electronics, electrical and mechanical undergraduate engineering branches.
Study through Anna University affiliation with the college’s autonomous curriculum and examinations.
Use laboratory coursework and practical design facilities alongside the four-year degree.
thingsToConsider: The August intake reference is the 2025-26 online first-year induction, not a future application deadline.
Tuition needs a written quotation for the relevant admission category before financial planning.
TNEA eligibility includes schooling, nativity and category rules beyond minimum subject marks.
bestFitFor: School-leavers seeking a four-year B.E. or B.Tech. after Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry.
Applicants who meet the relevant Tamil Nadu counselling or college admission-category requirements.
Students prepared to study at the main Poonamallee campus and plan hostel or daily travel costs.

faq.question: Is Panimalar a university?
faq.answer: Panimalar Engineering College is an autonomous college affiliated to Anna University. The UGC autonomous-college register lists autonomy for 2021-22 to 2030-31.

faq.question: Where is the main campus?
faq.answer: The main college is at Bangalore Trunk Road, Varadharajapuram, Poonamallee, Chennai 600123. Use counselling code 1210 to identify this institution.

faq.question: How long are B.E. and B.Tech. degrees?
faq.answer: The regular undergraduate regulations specify four years over eight semesters. Lateral entry has a different entry stage and requires separate eligibility checks.

faq.question: What is the teaching language?
faq.answer: English is the medium for undergraduate courses except courses related to Tamil, which follow their own language requirement.

faq.question: What subjects and marks are needed for undergraduate entry?
faq.answer: Applicants need Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry at higher-secondary level. The college lists 45% in the prescribed subjects for General-category applicants and 40% for the listed Tamil Nadu reserved categories.

faq.question: How does government-quota admission work?
faq.answer: TNEA counselling uses qualifying-examination marks and its rules on schooling, nativity, category and documentation. Minimum subject marks alone do not establish eligibility for every applicant.

faq.question: Is August a confirmed future intake?
faq.answer: The verified August reference is the 18–29 August 2025 online first-year induction timetable for 2025-26. It establishes that historical cohort’s induction; applicants must obtain later-cycle joining dates separately.

faq.question: What is the tuition fee?
faq.answer: The public mandatory disclosure refers to Tamil Nadu government norms without stating a numerical tuition rate. Obtain a written quotation for the programme and admission category, including compulsory charges.

faq.question: Are hostels available and what do they cost?
faq.answer: The 2026 TNEA directory lists permanent boys’ and girls’ hostels. Annual mess ₹50,000, room ₹50,000 and electricity ₹35,000 total ₹1,35,000 for each; confirm the current payable amount before booking.

faq.question: Are vegetarian meals available?
faq.answer: The TNEA directory lists both vegetarian and non-vegetarian mess provision for both hostels. Confirm any allergy or special-diet needs directly before joining.

faq.question: Can international students use this application route?
faq.answer: This profile establishes the regular domestic entry route. Foreign-national, NRI and other international category access needs separate written confirmation before applying.

faq.question: Does practical training guarantee a job?
faq.answer: Laboratory and project components support practical learning. Placement support and campus facilities do not guarantee an internship, salary or job offer.

faq.question: What are the postgraduate entry routes?
faq.answer: The college lists M.E. Computer Science and Engineering for B.E./B.Tech. CSE or IT graduates, M.E. Communication Systems for B.E. ECE graduates, and MBA for a recognised bachelor’s degree. Its current disclosure states 50% in main and allied subjects for the general quota. Confirm the accepted selection route, equivalence and any other category conditions.
